company.name: Incognia
company.shortDescription: Incognia is a next-generation identity solution that solves complex fraud, risk, and abuse problems.
company.description: Incognia is the innovator of next-generation identity solutions that enable secure and seamless digital experiences. With its persistent device fingerprint solution, Incognia combines best-in-class device recognition signals, location analysis and tamper detection for frictionless user verification and fraud prevention. Incognia’s customizable risk assessment and actionable insights empower companies in food delivery, ride-hailing, marketplace, and financial services to protect their reputation, retention and revenue.

productsAndServices.description: A cross-device user recognition solution combining app security, device identity, and location intelligence to detect fraud and reduce false positives.
productsAndServices.name: Incognia ID

productsAndServices.description: A solution that verifies users and addresses by binding device insights, indoor location, and physical address data into a unique identifier for fraud prevention and onboarding.
productsAndServices.name: Location Identity Verification

productsAndServices.description: A detection tool that flags devices as risky if they share indoor location signals with devices previously linked to fraud, helping stop recurring fraud and ban evasion.
productsAndServices.name: Environment Linked to Fraud (ELF) Detection

productsAndServices.description: A feature that detects and flags high-risk micro-locations associated with clusters of fraudulent devices to prevent organized fraud operations.
productsAndServices.name: Suspicious Locations

productsAndServices.description: A trial program allowing potential customers to test Incognia’s SDK in production to evaluate fraud prevention impact and ROI without disrupting existing processes.
productsAndServices.name: Proof of Value (POV) Program
